Large language models (LLMs) are advanced artificial intelligence systems trained on vast amounts of text data to understand and generate human-like language. They can answer questions, write stories, code, translate languages, and perform various tasks by analyzing patterns in the data. Their "large" designation refers to their scale—often containing billions of parameters and trained on diverse text sources. LLMs are revolutionizing fields like customer service, education, and content creation by enabling more natural and context-aware interactions. Examples include models like GPT, BERT, and others developed by companies like Alibaba Cloud.
